title: CF Meet Messaging common v1
description: Messaging vocabulary and messages (Part V Workstreams C–D): error envelope, security profiles, protocol / cipher suite, devices and their PUBLIC MLS material, registration challenges, KeyPackage publication, the key-transparency tree head and proofs, conversations, context classes, lifecycle, policies. Never a private key, group secret, ciphertext or plaintext content.

Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

registrationBinding.description: The exact RFC 9420 application_id leaf extension the registration KeyPackage must carry.

credentialIdentity.description: The exact BasicCredential identity of every KeyPackage of the device.

RegistrationChallenge.description: A single-use registration challenge with a server-assigned device id.

keyPackage.description: base64url of the registration KeyPackage (RFC 9420 MLSMessage, wire format mls_key_package).

signaturePublicKey.description: base64url Ed25519 MLS signature PUBLIC key (32 bytes).

Device.description: A Messaging device: PUBLIC key material only (never a private key).

logId.description: The deployment's key-transparency log (stable across key rotation); signed.

timestamp.description: When this head was produced (RFC 3339, microseconds).

timestampMicros.description: The same instant in Unix microseconds: exactly what the signature covers.

keyId.description: First 8 bytes (hex) of SHA-256 of the log's Ed25519 public key, which clients pin out of band.

signature.description: base64url Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the length-prefixed encoding of label 'cfmeet-messaging-kt-tree-head:v1', logId, treeSize (u64 BE), rootHash and timestampMicros (i64 BE) — packages/messaging-crypto transparency::tree_head_signing_input / verify_tree_head_signature (Part V G.5).

witnessStatus.description: The log is verifiable but not independently witnessed: not anti-equivocation, not production-certified key transparency.

TreeHead.description: A SIGNED tree head (Part V G.5). The signing key is a server secret distinct from the service-authentication key. Signed but not independently witnessed (AD-05): two valid signatures over different roots for one log and size prove equivocation, but nothing yet forces a log to show every client the same view.

leafData.description: base64url of the exact leaf bytes the log hashed (canonical JSON).

ContextClass.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

managedDisclosureAcknowledged.description: Regulated contexts: creating a MANAGED conversation requires acknowledging that the server can read its content (refused otherwise with MANAGED_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED).

CreateConversationRequest.description: A tenant / application / environment is never part of a request: it comes from the authenticated credential.

Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

UpdateConversationRequest.description: Optimistic concurrency on the aggregate version. EXPIRED is set by the server only. A security profile can never be changed (SECURITY_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE).

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

messages.description: Message features of later workstreams (replies, threads, reactions, pins): null = not yet available. Platform policy version 2.

EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

cryptographicRemoval.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the server-side removal is authorization only; a member's MLS commit removing the devices completes the cryptographic exclusion.

ciphertext.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the MLS PrivateMessage (MLSMessage bytes, base64url). Never plaintext.

notify.description: false: no push notification jobs (mirrored / migrated writes). Default true.

managedPresentation.description: MANAGED only (refused for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose presentation travels inside the ciphertext).

SendMessageRequest.description: Which fields apply is decided by the conversation's PERSISTED security profile: PRIVATE_E2EE needs deviceId, epoch and ciphertext and refuses text (CONTENT_REJECTED / PLAINTEXT_IN_E2EE); MANAGED needs text and refuses ciphertext.

securityProvenance.description: NATIVE: created through Messaging. LEGACY_MANAGED: imported from a legacy chat store (MANAGED only, never presented as end-to-end encrypted).

oneOf.description: LEGACY_MANAGED: the original time at the legacy source.

channel.description: IN_APP, or SMS: arrived through the SMS Bridge (MANAGED only; never end-to-end encrypted).

Message.description: A message. Content (ciphertext or MANAGED text) only while ACTIVE. e2ee for PRIVATE_E2EE rows, managed for MANAGED rows; the acceptance digest binds the server sequence and id to the ciphertext (cfmeet-messaging-acceptance:v2).

PermalinkResolution.description: A permalink is never authority: resolution checks current membership; a non-member and an unknown id are the same NOT_FOUND.

data.description: camelCase payload; message events carry the message's CURRENT representation (a deleted message replays as a tombstone).

ConversationEvent.description: A durable conversation event (derived from committed state, replayable by its per-conversation eventSequence).

syncRequired.description: The requested position is older than the retained event window: resynchronize messages by sequence.

CommitRequest.description: An MLS Commit created in the group's current epoch. removedDeviceIds is the committer's attestation of the leaves it removes; while removals are pending it must cover them all.

ClientToken.description: A short-lived Messaging Client Access Token (compact JWS, EdDSA, typ cfmeet-mcat+jwt) bound to tenant, application, environment, principal, device and session. Device-direct use only: POST /v1/realtime/tickets.

RealtimeTicket.description: Single-use, seconds-long WebSocket ticket, presented as a Sec-WebSocket-Protocol entry (never in the URL).

pushDeliveryConfigured.description: false: no push adapter / credentials for this platform in this deployment; jobs end NOT_CONFIGURED (never reported delivered).

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

Attachment.description: An attachment's authorized metadata and lifecycle. Bytes live in protected object storage under a server-generated key.

size.description: Exact byte size of the stored object (ciphertext for PRIVATE_E2EE).

mediaType.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: always application/octet-stream (the real type is protected inside MLS).

oneOf.description: MANAGED only: sanitized presentation name (never a storage key).
MANAGED only, client-declared presentation metadata (durations are NOT verified by the server).

scan.description: PRIVATE_E2EE attachments are ciphertext: never scanned and never reported as scanned (NOT_APPLICABLE_ENCRYPTED).

upload.description: A signed single-object upload bound to the exact size (content-length), SHA-256 (x-amz-checksum-sha256) and content type: the store rejects any other bytes. Send exactly these headers.

mediaType.description: MANAGED: required, in the kind's allow-list. PRIVATE_E2EE: omit (or application/octet-stream).

deviceId.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: the uploading device (the acting principal's).

residualAccessSeconds.description: A grant issued before a revocation stays usable at most this long; GET .../content re-checks authorization on every request.

AttachmentDownloadGrant.description: A short-lived signed read of one object forcing Content-Disposition: attachment and the stored content type. Issued only after authorization (current membership, history window, message ACTIVE, attachment READY).

LegalHold.description: A legal / compliance hold: held items are never purged or deleted. For PRIVATE_E2EE it preserves ciphertext and metadata only; it never creates a decryption capability.

SearchResults.description: Server search covers MANAGED conversations only; PRIVATE_E2EE conversations are searched on devices (LOCAL_SEARCH_ONLY).

disclosure.description: PRIVATE_E2EE only and optional: what the reporter's own device decrypted, disclosed voluntarily (sealed at rest; presented as unverifiable).

ReportReceipt.description: What the reporter learns: that the report was received. The reported principal is never told who reported.

ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

DeletionRequest.description: Legal holds win: held items are preserved and counted (PARTIALLY_HELD).

SyncResult.description: applied=false: the update is stale or a replay (source version at or below the last applied one) and changed nothing.

items.description: The canonical Messaging message of every imported or already-imported legacy message (the legacy system's stable id mapping).

MeetingMessageModeration.description: Removal of a meeting-conversation message by the meeting authority (which already compared the host's role with the sender's). Idempotent.

ContextAuthorityUpdate.description: Part V H §103: the current authority of a peer-owned communication context (opaque reference only; never a telephone number or contact value). Version-fenced; REVOKED / SUSPENDED apply even to a suspended tenant, ACTIVE needs full authority.

SmsBridgeDisclosure.description: Part V H §106: the disclosure a bridge creator must acknowledge (version-pinned).

CreateSmsBridgeRequest.description: Bridge a MANAGED conversation to one external party by SMS. The number is passed to the SMS Gateway once and never stored by Messaging. A PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is never bridged (E2EE_CONVERSATION_NOT_BRIDGEABLE).

SmsTransport.description: Carrier state of one bridged message — separate from in-app delivery and read state (§110).

InboundSms.description: An inbound SMS of a bridged party (SMS Gateway → Messaging, messaging-sms-bridge.deliver).
